testcase.name: Scenario: Change one command display option with two rows selected: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:665:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change one command display option with two rows selected ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog has an initially empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the user has staged "2D Sketches" followed by "3D Annotations" ✔ And the Large option is clear for both commands ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" and presses Shift+Down ✔ And the user checks Large on the "2D Sketches" row ✔ Then Large is checked for "2D Sketches" ✔ And Large remains clear for "3D Annotations" ✔ And both rows remain selected ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is displayed on the Tools ribbon
